terminal_record.title: Unverified Allegation: DOJ Shelved Campaign-Finance Matters Involving Trump Allies
terminal_record.description_short: The supplied record alleges selective DOJ non-enforcement but names no case, referral, directive, or disposition.
terminal_record.description_medium: An internal packet alleges that Pam Bondi’s DOJ stopped pursuing campaign-finance matters involving Trump allies and affiliated PACs by April 2025. It names dark-money, straw-donor, and foreign-contribution matters but supplies no case numbers, referrals, or disposition records. Public documents show separate actions by DOJ and the FEC, but do not establish the alleged department-wide policy. Keep the allegation marked unverified pending case-level records; this card is not eligible for publication.
terminal_record.date_precision: Month only as supplied; event day not established.

source_fact_map.fact: The April 24 White House memorandum directed DOJ to investigate allegations concerning straw-donor and foreign contributions through online fundraising platforms.
source_fact_map.quote: Therefore, I direct the Attorney General, in consultation with the Secretary of the Treasury, to use all lawful authority, as necessary, to investigate allegations regarding the unlawful use of online fundraising platforms to make “straw” or “dummy” contributions or foreign contributions to political candidates and committees, and to take all appropriate actions to enforce the law.
source_fact_map.source_excerpt: Therefore, I direct the Attorney General, in consultation with the Secretary of the Treasury, to use all lawful authority, as necessary, to investigate allegations regarding the unlawful use of online fundraising platforms to make “straw” or “dummy” contributions or foreign contributions to political candidates and committees, and to take all appropriate actions to enforce the law.

source_fact_map.fact: The FEC's April 29 certification records a 4-0 vote dismissing specified reporting allegations against named Trump political committees; this was an FEC action, not a DOJ disposition.
source_fact_map.quote: the Commission decided by a vote of 4-0 to take the following actions: MUR 8251: 1. Dismiss the allegation that Never Surrender, Inc., f/k/a Donald J. Trump for President 2024, Inc.
source_fact_map.source_excerpt: AMENDED CERTIFICATION I, Laura E. Sinram, Secretary and Clerk of the Federal Election Commission, do hereby certify that on April 29, 2025, the Commission decided by a vote of 4-0 to take the following actions: MUR 8251: 1. Dismiss the allegation that Never Surrender, Inc., f/k/a Donald J. Trump for President 2024, Inc., and Bradley T. Crate in his official capacity as treasurer; Trump Save America Joint Fundraising Committee and Bradley T. Crate in his official capacity as treasurer; Save America and Bradley T. Crate in his official capacity as treasurer; Trump Make America Great Again Committee and Bradley T. Crate in his official capacity as treasurer; and Make America Great Again PAC and Bradley T. Crate in his official capacity as treasurer misreported disbursements to Red Curve Solutions, LLC, in violation of 52 U.S.C. § 30104(b)(5), (6) and 11 C.F.R. §§ 104.3(b)(4), 104.9.
